answer: Each epoch a public lottery pairs every identity with one counterpart drawn from the wider nebula. Both must lock a small sable bond, then complete a timed two-way exchange: each side sends a fresh whisper nonce and returns a signed transform of the other's nonce within seconds. Only pairs that finish both legs on time keep their bond and gain weight. One operator can attend only a few exchanges at once, so a farm leaves most names silent, their bonds burned, and their influence at zero.
